facts.business: Maxgrow India Limited underwent a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, with a resolution plan approved by the NCLT and implemented by a Monitoring Agency (IMA) until December 2024; the company's specific ongoing business operations are not described in the provided excerpts.
key_risks: Company underwent Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under IBC, 2016
Records and operations were under transition post-resolution plan approval
Incomplete statutory registers, records, forms, and returns unavailable for audit verification
Certain records relating to earlier periods not available, not traceable, or not properly maintained
Non-filing of shareholding pattern, corporate governance report, related party transaction disclosures, and reconciliation audit reports within stipulated timelines
Lack of prior intimation for board meetings considering financial results
facts.related_party_note: Loan to inter company includes a sum of Rs. 2,55,40,000 outstanding from UNNAO TRADING PVT LTD in which the erstwhile director was interested. Share application money pending allotment in Sainath Herbal Care Marketing Private Limited (Rs. 320.00 Lakhs) and Swastik Legal Consultants Private Limited (Rs. 39.00 Lakhs).
